name: The Home of Pleasure
source:
The Home of Pleasure begins as a slice of life dating sim with a focus on realism. You play as a 25 year old man living a relatively uninteresting life until a young woman gets in touch and changes everything.
After the Prologue and Episode 1, the game will slowly transition into a high stakes, drama fueled love-fest full of danger, crime, and debauchery.
